variants.label: staircase fold of all five big rooms + row squeeze
variants.architecture: Same fold as plotter_06 and sudoku_04 (src/littleman/alexey_stairfold.py). All five big rooms pass ports_are_single_walled. R2-R5 fold completely (21-23 merges each, 7/7 every time). R1 does NOT: of the 35 merges available there, the 35th is unsafe and drops it to 5/7. A binary search over the merge prefix found 34 safe. 110 rows removed globally by a rows-only squeeze, ticks down 21%.
variants.verdict: BEST (vs tarstars' gradebook_03 at ~74B). Width 386 now binds -- it is four 94-wide rooms side by side, and their columns are frozen by zone resolution, so further row folding is banked, not cashed.
